# The MCP document tools take every scoped kind (spec, map, capability with task = key or name) and…

The MCP document tools take every scoped kind (spec, map, capability with task = key or name) and a section's delta; task_upsert takes ticket_type and blocked_by; where_we_left_off names a task's spec or map; the old kinds stay until #185

No new tools: doc_get and doc_section_upsert already address a document by kind and scope, so Pocock's kinds fit them; the enum comes from DOC_KINDS and SCOPED_KINDS. The "--" key ban stays for analysis only, since spec deltas use "<capability>--<requirement>". Views are #190's.
